genius.notes: No public U.S. GENIUS approval, official application, state qualification or foreign-issuer registration was located for Techteryx/TUSD in the checked sources on October 7, 2026. The existing warning-or-notice classification records the historical September 2024 SEC action concerning TUSD investment contracts against TrueCoin LLC and TrustToken Inc.; Techteryx was not a respondent. SEC Litigation Release 26126 was independently reopened in a dedicated browser after static HTTP 403 and confirms the parties, token and settlement announcement, which was subject to court approval at publication. The October 7 Moore report names Techteryx Ltd. as current issuer; the existing issuerEntity string Techteryx is preserved. The report provides reasonable assurance over issued-token and collateral balances at cost, with fair-value, liquidity and credit-risk limitations. Its additional management notes are outside the assurance scope. Daily reserve reporting supports the attestation-presence field but does not establish GENIUS authorization or reserve compliance. GENIUS remains pre-effective; the general DASP licensed-issuer offer/sale provision has a separate three-year clock.

negativeEvidenceReview.summary: As of October 7, 2026, the specified regulator materials, issuer disclosures and exact-name public searches yielded no TUSD/Techteryx GENIUS approval, official application, state qualification or foreign registration. This is a bounded public-evidence conclusion. Treasury SCRC state certification procedures do not establish a foreign-issuer permission. The historical SEC action names TrueCoin and TrustToken, while the current issuer is Techteryx; no present Techteryx issuance prohibition is inferred.
